full_text:
Article 4 (Contents of the Obligatory Fund Establishment Plan) The obligatory fund establishment plan, as defined in Article 5(1) of the Act, must include the following items:
1. The name of the obligatory fund
2. The reasons and objectives for establishing the obligatory fund
3. Methods and plans for securing and operating the fund
4. When two or more agricultural organizations jointly establish and operate a single obligatory fund, the methods and procedures for its operation
